news.paragraph: Silver prices are facing pressure due to weakening demand, according to recent analysis. Despite a significant year-to-date gain for SLV, concerns are being raised about its 0.50% fee and a substantial 28% tax rate, which may diminish investor returns. Some reports suggest that alternative silver ETFs might be outperforming SLV, indicating potential headwinds for the fund.
